Seeking senior level assignments in GCC Sales, Corporate Business Development/ Team Management with

an organization of high repute.

Executive Profile

Senior Sales & Business Development Leader with 16+ years of experience driving GCC sales, GTM strategy, corporate business development, and client acquisition across consulting, insurance, and financial services. Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, building CXO-level relationships, and leading high-performing teams. Recognized for consistently delivering growth, expanding market share, and positioning organizations as trusted partners in GCC markets.

Core Competencies

GCC Sales Strategy & Account-based Growth  Business Development & Market Expansion  Client Relationship Management  Revenue Generation & Cross-functional Sales  Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Professional Experience

Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP Associate Director – Sales (Jun 2026 – Present)

Leading GCC account-based sales and new client onboarding.   Driving domestic client acquisition and managing OMP portfolio.  Spearheading Hyderabad eminence & events for brand positioning.

Growth Office Manager (Jun 2024 – May 2026)

Leading GCC account-based sales and new client onboarding.   Driving domestic client acquisition and managing OMP portfolio.  Spearheading Hyderabad eminence & events for brand positioning.

Manager – Risk Advisory (Oct 2022 – May 2024)

Expanded GCC & GIC engagements in Risk Advisory.  Added new logos, across green dot.  Strengthened South India market presence in compliance & governance.  Enhanced client penetration across region and onboarded new client logos.

Aditya Birla Insurance Brokers Ltd. Area Head (2019 – 2022)

Acquired new clients and retained key accounts through CXO engagement.  Consistently overachieved sales targets; top-rated in ABG DAC Leadership program.  Handled large Power Sector Portfolio.

Atlas Financial Research & Consulting Pvt. Ltd. Vice President – Business Development (2018 – 2019)

 Delivered highest sales in company history, driving record topline growth.

Dun & Bradstreet Strategic Account Manager (2015 – 2018)

New client acquisition + existing portfolio retention (Hunting & Farming)  Achieved 100%+ targets year-on-year.  Awarded Star Performer for outstanding sales results.

Ticker Plant Ltd. (FTIL Subsidiary) Assistant Manager – Marketing & BD (2015)

Expanded client base in AP & Telangana through sector-focused sales.

CRISIL Ltd. Team Leader – Business Development (2011 – 2015)

Handled a 12-member team.   Ranked #1 in South India for business acquisition (2012 to 2014).  Awarded for outstanding performance two consecutive years.

Increased market shared from 36%-67% in mid corporate business.

Cubex Tubings Ltd. Engineer – Marketing & Operations (2009 – 2011)

Awarded Employee of the Year (2010-11) for highest business generation.

Education & Certifications

Composite Insurance Broker (2019)  General Insurance Training – Insurance Institute of India (2019)  Google Digital Marketing Certification (2018)  Accelerated Sales Development – ISB (2017)  Executive Program in Sales & Marketing – IIM Calcutta (2016)  B.Tech (EEE) – JNTU Hyderabad (2010)

IT Skills

CRM Tools: Salesforce, Microsoft CRM, Jupiter CRM, CRM Next  MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Languages

English | Hindi | Telugu
